installation: scripts/install.sh completed; production frontend build completed; tests/product and tests/connectors passed (32 tests).
observed: The real service failed FastAPI lifespan startup when Core.start attempted to spawn a worker. s9.sandbox.worker_command intentionally rejects non-macOS because the only implemented process sandbox is /usr/bin/sandbox-exec.
impact: Linux runtime/API/browser checks, including scope denials and stopped-runtime guard, did not execute. Linux cold dependency/build/test validation is partial evidence only; Linux is not a supported runtime claim.
follow_up: Retain macOS as the supported runtime for this handoff. A Linux runtime requires an independently reviewed sandbox with equivalent filesystem and network boundaries, not an unsandboxed worker fallback.
